sql: WITH t AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, upper(market_ticker) AS mkt, upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS ev, pnl::numeric/quantity*100 AS c, CASE WHEN coalesce(side,'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END::numeric AS entry FROM paper_trades WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) AND upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) IN ('KXNPBGAME','KXUFCMOV','KXATPMATCH','KXFEDMENTION','KXBRENTW','KXMLBKS','KXUCLTOTAL','KXLIGAMXTOTAL','KXRT','KXWTACHALLENGERMATCH') ), k AS ( SELECT series, mkt, c, entry, CASE WHEN series IN ('KXFEDMENTION','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY','KXTRUMPSAYMONTH','KXWCATTEND','KXWCFIRSTSONG','KXWCMENTION') THEN mkt WHEN ev='' THEN mkt ELSE series||':'||ev END AS g FROM t ), w AS (SELECT series, g, sum(c) AS s FROM k GROUP BY 1,2), wa AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS cnts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s<0) AS lcnts FROM w GROUP BY 1), tr AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS n, round(avg(entry),1) AS entry, round(avg(c),2) AS mean, round(sum(c)/100,2) AS tot, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c<0)/count(*),2) AS lr, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c>0),3) AS aw, round(abs(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c<0)),3) AS al FROM k GROUP BY 1) SELECT tr.series||'|'||tr.n||'|'||tr.entry||'|'||tr.mean||'|'||tr.tot||'|'||tr.lr ||'|'||coalesce(tr.aw::text,'0')||'|'||coalesce(tr.al::text,'0') ||'|'||wa.cnts||'|'||wa.lcnts AS row FROM tr JOIN wa ON wa.series=tr.series ORDER BY tr.series
